details:
I can't give exact steps for this one, but it's been a recurring issue for months, both on stable and beta.

Occasionally, I'll find that from some angles, pickups in many worlds can't be highlighted or selected. I haven't figured out any properly consistent pattern, but this seems to be more common after a pickup has moved. When this happens, it tends to happen as a result of a script moving the object, or after dropping a pickup - I haven't been able to identify any specific way to do it consistently.

It seems to occur more on objects that move by some means - either via physics, or via a script moving a kinematic body.

When it happens, you often cannot highlight the object except from a very awkward (and generally random) angle. At times, the location you have to aim at isn't even on the object - but the highlight still appears in the object's location. It's as if the raycast is being aimed in a totally wrong direction, though it is only isolated to these objects.

When it is offset, it's not like the entire object's surface is the position you can aim at, either. The area you can usually highlight from is very small, and hard to discern. It behaves more like you have a very awkwardly placed invisible and moving surface placed somewhere that blocks your ability to interact with it except from some unknown angle.

However, once you manage to pick it up, it seems to correct itself and the pickup can be interacted with normally again, unless whatever condition that triggers this issue re-occurs - but this isn't common to see.
title: Pickups occasionally can't be highlighted/used in desktop mode
